test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three numbers, 1, 2 and 3, and three letters, X, Y and Z, are written on the different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the given figure. Find the letter/number on the face opposite to Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ac4653a1ee41347c1f01ef78fb31ee93a52de985409c564576afa0f92c4c8c8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 is common on both the dices, it is clear that X, 3, Z, and 2 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. Y will be opposite to it.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f386ba7f91a76a64f85071a14844e3ef26eb79b24e70407d2387e250ff79d986.png] 

Opposite pairs:

X → 2

3 → Z

1 → Y

So, the opposite side of "Y" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
